title: Transport Data Science
text:
About the Book
Transport Data Science (TDS) is an emerging field at the intersection of transport planning, geography, and data science. This book aims to provide:

Reproducible workflows using Python and R.
Practical examples covering spatial data analysis, routing, and network analysis.
Future-proof concepts built on modern tools like Quarto, Pixi, and GitHub Actions.

Stay tuned as we expand the chapters!

title: 1  Introduction
text:
1.1 Why Transport Data Science?
This is the introduction to Transport Data Science.
Transport Data Science is an exciting, interdisciplinary field that leverages computational methods, geographic information systems (GIS), and data science techniques to solve transport challenges.
The transport sector generates vast amounts of data, including: - GPS tracks and mobile phone records - Smart card and ticketing system data - Traffic sensors and cameras - OpenStreetMap and public transit schedules (GTFS)
Data science tools help transport planners and researchers make sense of this data to design more efficient, sustainable, and equitable transport systems.
